title: Bano Qabil 5.0 Overview & Leadership
text: Bano Qabil 5.0 is the latest mega-scale IT initiative by Alkhidmat Foundation, launched Jan 3, 2026, at Expo Centre Karachi. Led by Patron-in-Chief Hafiz Naeem ur Rehman and Chairman Naveed Ali Baig. It provides 100% free IT training for youth aged 14-30. Artificial Intelligence (AI) is now a mandatory component of every single course.

title: Karachi Campuses: North & Central Clusters
text: Campuses in this region include: Al Huda Campus (North Karachi Power House), Anjuman Complex (Sakhi Hasan/North Nazimabad), Liaquatabad (JI Office), Nazimabad Block 5 (Pakistan Central Homeopathic Medical College), and Gulberg Campus.

title: Karachi Campuses: East, Gulshan & Jauhar Clusters
text: Campuses in this region include: Idara Noor-e-Haq (H.O. Quaideen Colony), Circle Social Welfare (13D Gulshan), Al-Aqsa (Gulshan), Safoora (Jauhar), Umer-e-Farooq Masjid (PIA Society), Bahadurabad (Escuela & Askari College), and PECHS Harmain School (Block 6).

title: Karachi Campuses: South, Lyari & West Clusters
text: Campuses in this region include: Clifton (Punjab Chowrangi), Garden (Asa Jalal Complex), Lyari (Moosa Lane, Kharadar KMA Protech, HOL Kara Bai), SITE Metroville, Keamari (SKIT), Orangi Town 11.5, and Baldia Town (Piston College).

title: Karachi Campuses: Malir, Korangi & Modern Hubs
text: Campuses in this region include: Malir (Kausar Town), Korangi (Allah Wala Town), Landhi 6 (JI Office), Shah Faisal (Jamia Millia & Dr. Mehmood Hussain), Shah Latif Town, Bahria Town Karachi, Gulshan-e-Hadeed, and Gulshan-e-Maymar (Etawa & Sherwani Suites).

title: Nationwide Presence (86+ Campuses)
text: Bano Qabil operates across Pakistan: Punjab (27 campuses including Lahore Gulberg III), KPK (33 including Peshawar, Swat, Mardan), Islamabad (10 centers), Balochistan (5 in Quetta), Sindh Interior (8 including Hyderabad/Sukkur), Gilgit-Baltistan (5), and Azad Kashmir (3).

title: Courses: AI, Software & Coding Path
text: Advanced Courses: Generative AI (LLMs & RAG), Prompt Engineering, Web Development with AI, MERN Stack, Frontend (Next.js 15), Python (FastAPI), Flutter Mobile Apps, Unity Game Dev, SQA Automation, and No-Code AI Orchestration.

title: Courses: Marketing, E-Commerce & Creative Path
text: Courses: Digital Marketing & Freelancing, Amazon FBA VA, Shopify, Daraz Ecosystem, UI/UX (Figma), Graphic Design, Video Editing (After Effects/Premiere), Content Writing, and Digital Journalism.

title: Admission Roadmap & Security Deposit
text: The 5-step process: Online Registration (banoqabil.pk), Aptitude Test, Interview, Security Deposit, and Campus Selection. A PKR 3,000 security deposit is required, which is strictly refundable after course completion and exam appearance.

title: Career Services: Qabil.jobs & Incubation
text: Qabil.jobs is the official job portal launched in Jan 2026 for digital CVs and job matching. Incubation Centers provide hands-on project support. Certifications are verified by SBTE, SDC, and LRN (International).

title: Guidance: Course Selection Advice
text: Students should choose Web Dev/AI for coding careers, Digital Marketing/Amazon for e-commerce business, or Graphic Design/Video Editing for creative fields. Every student is advised to start freelancing on Fiverr/Upwork during training.

title: Mentorship: Student Success Strategy
text: For maximum success, students must maintain 80% attendance, complete 3 hands-on projects in the incubation center, and attend Bano Qabil Job Fairs at Idara Noor-e-Haq.
